page.overview:
Who is Teiko Shinazugawa?

Teiko was a girl of average height and light skin complexion. Her black hair was tied in a bow in the back and she had large almond-shaped purple eyes. She was very similar in appearance to her brother Sanemi.

She wore a mint green kimono lined with white waving stripes and tied with a lime green obi.

Teiko, like her siblings, was a caring and loving young child. She loved her mother dearly and cared for her wellbeing, shielding her eyes during one of her father's abusive outbursts because she could not stand to see the violence and staying up late to wait for her to come home when she was late.

When she woke up to find Sanemi and her mother was not home at night, she looked to Genya as comfort, warmly addressing her older brother.
